title: Legacy output echoes claim data changed after submission
notes: The submitted 837 totals 1250.00; the vendor-processed file echoes it, while the MAC-processed file echoes 1180.00 (line 3 charge 130.00 instead of 200.00) with a received date nine days after submission. Total charge is a key field, so the MAC claim is missing and the vendor claim is extra. Follows the cause of a correction made in the legacy system's online entry screens after a return to provider.
